rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent elongated mass across views, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are decent. However, it behaves mostly as a sealed bent bar with only a thin split at the top/center, while the program brief requires an active ground threshold and a meaningful public void or terrace. The blue frontage edge is not answered by a legible entry seam, court, or undercut; the mass is effectively opposite to the access requirement. In section, the form remains low and continuous but does not yet express a public ground condition or a stronger program hierarchy. It is closer to a generic compact bar than a neighborhood living mass with clear public-facing openness, so program_fit_hard_pass fails.
